head: hex
notes: Length conflict: AMK B-14144 3/8-16 x 1-3/8 GR5; camaros.net forum says AMK B-10082 flanged 3/8-18[sic, likely 3/8-16] x 1-1/4 Gr5. GMPartsWiki: replaced by 9420462. Bellhousing-to-engine use matches AIM M40. | Round 4: Searched 'B-10082 AMK', '179842 bolt bellhousing'. 4speedconversions GM bellhousing table independently gives 179842 = hex head 3/8-16 x 1-3/8, agreeing with AMK B-14144. The camaros.net 1-1/4 flanged figure is a forum post naming two GM numbers (179842/3828782) and an AMK substitute (B-10082 = 3/8-16 x 1-1/4 flange bolt), so it likely describes 3828782 / a substitute. Resolved to 1-3/8; superseded by 9420462.
